limitations: These parallel API comparisons do not reclassify native compiler tests or establish full-suite/API compatibility.
Only reviewed flat IO Unit actions are adapted; other types, scopes, guards and sidecars are rejected.
Source-hidden relocation with empty PATH removes ordinary build dependencies; it is not kernel-enforced filesystem isolation.
Other operating systems and architectures remain unvalidated by this local campaign.
